data.narrative:
Performance Drone Works, founded by Ryan Gury, is a Series B-stage company in the Drones & Autonomous sector that has raised $110M+ to date. The broader peer universe consists of 8 private companies in drones and autonomous systems, including Elroy Air, Zipline, Joby Aviation, Nuro, and Archer Aviation. No public comparables exist in this narrow subsector.

Given data constraints, only one valuation method was reliably applicable. The Stage-Progression approach uses the $110M total raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement to subsequent rounds, yielding an implied valuation of $209M. A Peer-Median approach could not be applied: while five same-sector peers exist, none provided sufficient data points at the same stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier to establish a credible narrow-set median. Relying on broader sector medians would introduce material distortion given sector heterogeneity.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $178M to $240M, centered on $209M. This range reflects uncertainty bands around the single applicable method rather than triangulation across multiple independent approaches. Key limitations include the absence of directly comparable same-stage peer financials and reliance on historical stage-step multiples, which may not fully reflect this company's specific capital efficiency, market position, or technical differentiation. Further valuation refinement would require either peer-level financial disclosure or market transaction data from similar-stage companies in autonomous systems.
